items.name: Bulldog Winter 2022

venue.name: Green Middle School
venue.address: 1711 Steese Road, Uniontown, Ohio, 44865 United States

items.information:
Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, December 24th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

OR

2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, Jan 4th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

items.name: Cubing Is Back Raipur 2022

venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#16737-registrations-payments.)

Please note once you register in WCA site for the Cubing Is Back Raipur 2022, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.
We will be dividing all the particiapants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration.

***Quick Info links:***
[**Event Schedule**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#competition-schedule)
**[Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#16737-registrations-payments)**

items.information:

This is a series competition with [Northside Duology Part 1 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthsideDuologyPart12022).  You may register for **ONLY ONE** competition in the series.  If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition.

items.information:
Registration has closed for this competition because both the competitor list and waiting list are full.

## COVID Notice - Masks are required for this competition. You may only bring one spectator with you at maximum. Spectators that are not accompanying a competitor will be turned away.

For the first competition of 2022, we are happy to welcome you back to the Springs for a jam packed day of speedcubing fun! This will be the same venue as all previous competitions in the city.

This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering.

Due to COVID-19 restrictions, the competitor limit for this competition is 50 competitors. Competitors are being asked to bring only one spectator maximum to the competition, and if possible, to attend alone.
